topic.label: Currencies and Foreign Exchange
topic.desc: Money across borders: currency pairs and FX markets, exchange rate drivers and central banks, cross-border payments, and hedging currency risk.

concepts.label: Exchange Rate Drivers and Central Banks
concepts.desc: Interest rate differentials, inflation, trade balances, central bank policy and intervention.

concepts.label: Currency Risk Hedging
concepts.desc: Hedging FX exposure with forwards, options and natural hedges.

concepts.label: Currency Pairs and FX Markets
concepts.desc: Spot FX, currency pairs, quotes, pips and the over-the-counter FX market.

concepts.label: Cross-Border Payments
concepts.desc: Sending money across borders: SWIFT, correspondent banking, remittances, fees and timing.

skills.label: Rate Differential Analyzer
skills.desc: Explains a currency move by rate differentials and central bank policy.

skills.label: FX Exposure Hedger
skills.desc: Measures a company's currency exposure and proposes a hedge.

skills.label: Currency Converter
skills.desc: Converts amounts between currencies at a stated rate and source.

skills.label: FX Quote Explainer
skills.desc: Explains a currency quote, base and quote currency, pips and cross rates.

skills.label: Cross-Border Payment Planner
skills.desc: Plans a cross-border payment route with fees, timing and compliance checks.

mcp.name: Polygon MCP
mcp.desc: Polygon.io MCP server: market data for stocks, options, indices, forex and crypto, aggregates, trades, quotes, reference data and financials.

mcp.name: Twelve Data MCP
mcp.desc: Twelve Data MCP server: real time and historical prices for stocks, forex, crypto, ETFs and indices, technical indicators.
